## Summary

Describe what changed and why it belongs in TanSail.

## Impact

Explain the user or developer impact, including migration or compatibility considerations.

## Validation

- [ ] `vp check`
- [ ] `vp test run`
- [ ] `vp build`
- [ ] `TANSAIL_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome pnpm test:visual` when UI or routing changed

## Project checklist

- [ ] The change is typed, config-driven, and removable when it is optional.
- [ ] The default starter still works without secrets or paid services.
- [ ] New UI remains accessible and works in light and dark themes.
- [ ] Documentation and `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` are updated when applicable.
- [ ] No closed-source implementation, proprietary asset, credential, or project-specific content was copied into the repository.
